WITH orders_by_user AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) as order_date
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) as order_num
  FROM orders_by_user
),
first_second AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_num = 1 THEN order_date END) as first_order_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_num = 2 THEN order_date END) as second_order_date
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE order_num <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM (second_order_date - first_order_date)))::numeric, 2) as median_days
FROM first_second

WITH user_cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi 
        WHERE oi.user_id = u.id 
          AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
          AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      ) THEN 1 
      ELSE 0 
    END AS has_order
  FROM public.users u
  WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(acquisition_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
  ROUND((SUM(has_order)::double precision / COUNT(*))::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM user_cohorts
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 1

WITH orders_2024 AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    user_id,
    MIN(created_at) AS order_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS order_value,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Cancelled') AS non_cancelled_count
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
orders_with_non_cancelled AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM orders_2024
  WHERE non_cancelled_count > 0
),
user_first_order AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date
  FROM orders_with_non_cancelled
  GROUP BY user_id
),
classified_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    o.order_value,
    CASE 
      WHEN o.order_date = ufo.first_order_date THEN 'first'
      ELSE 'repeat'
    END AS order_type
  FROM orders_with_non_cancelled o
  JOIN user_first_order ufo ON o.user_id = ufo.user_id
),
medians AS (
  SELECT 
    order_type,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_value
  FROM classified_orders
  GROUP BY order_type
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT median_value FROM medians WHERE order_type = 'first') - 
  (SELECT median_value FROM medians WHERE order_type = 'repeat') AS difference
